instruction: A candid documentary photograph in a medium shot captures a bright indoor study room. On the left, the woman in the black blazer and glasses (R2) sits at a wooden desk, holding up a black pen and smiling as she speaks. On the right, the young man with bleached blonde hair (R1) in a blue plaid shirt turns his head to look at her, listening with a soft smile. They sit side-by-side at the desk scattered with papers, a calculator, and a laptop, with a green potted plant on the window sill in the background. The scene is filled with soft, natural daylight, creating a warm, collaborative mood.
